messages:
Noah Patel: Quick sync — proposing a small-batch reactivation newsletter to warm dormant trial signups ahead of the March benchmark webinar. Two-part plan: (1) 1-off reactivation with a tight CTA to RSVP; (2) follow-up drip only for opens. Want to keep this lightweight and measurable. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Lina Duarte: Sounds good. For segmentation I suggest we avoid the usual large cohorts and instead target two micro-segments: (1) trial_signed_30-90d_no_activity, (2) webinar_interested_but_no_rsvp. Keeps noise down and gives cleaner lift signal.

Ben Ortiz: Agree. Also recommend a seed list of 50 internal emails (ops + sales) and 200 external VIPs so we can check deliverability and rendering. We'll run seeds 24h prior. :mag:

Jules (Design): For the creative: single-column template, one hero, 2 CTAs (RSVP + SNOOZE preference). Keep images under 50KB. I'll attach mobile preview before QA.

Noah Patel: Subject test ideas — please vote A/B: A) "We saved you a seat — product benchmarks + live Q&A" B) "Benchmarks that cut inference costs (webinar)". Also thinking an urgency variant: C) "Last seats for Friday's benchmark webinar". Want to test subject semantic vs urgency.

Lina Duarte: My vote: A vs B (keep C as a holdout for high-intent only). We'll randomize within each micro-segment 40/40/20.

Ben Ortiz: Deliverability flags: set SPF/DKIM check prior to send, throttle by ESP to 30 emails/min for the first 30 mins, monitor bounce and complaint streams. If complaint_rate > 0.1% cancel remaining sends. Also configure seed alerts.

Deliverability Bot: automated: SPF/DKIM: OK on namespace redwood.ai; domain reputation: good; last 30d complaint_rate: 0.02%. Seed check recommended.

Maya Rivera: Copy notes — keep body <= 140 words, highlight one metric from recent benchmark (e.g., "20% lower per-token cost with quantized variants"), short testimonial line, RSVP button first. Also include an alternate link to view benchmarks on docs.

Noah Patel: Follow-up drip plan: only send to those who open but don't RSVP. Sequence: Day 1: short reminder + one data point; Day 3: customer mini-case + RSVP; Day 6: final reminder + "missed you" variant. Non-openers get no follow-up. That keeps measurement clean.

Lina Duarte: For measurement, define primary KPI = RSVP rate within 7 days; secondary = webinar attendance, tertiary = D14 conversion to paid. We'll mirror tags: utm_campaign=react-2620, segment=micro1|micro2, subj=A|B|C.

Ben Ortiz: Ops ask: can marketing ops create the cohorts and a test send of 500 each? Also need a suppression check against bounced/complaint_address list.

Maya Rivera: Ops can you also seed-check SMS fallback list for attendees who RSVP? We'll want to capture high-intent leads quickly.

Ben Ortiz: I can create suppression and cohorts today. Will post the SQL snippet for the micro-segments:```SELECT user_id FROM trials WHERE created_at BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 90 DAY) AND DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND last_active IS NULL;```

Jules (Design): Uploaded mobile + dark-mode previews to the drive. Also made a compact header for smaller screen sizes.

Deliverability Bot: automated: Recommended throttle: 30/min initial, then ramp to 120/min over 2 hours. Monitor for spikes in soft_bounces.

Noah Patel: Action items summary:
- Ben: create cohorts, suppression, and run seed sends (Ben)
- Jules: finalize templates and previews (Jules)
- Lina: finalize subject variants and randomization plan (Lina)
- Maya: coordinate landing page with prefilled params and RSVP ingest (Maya)
- Ops: run SPF/DKIM final check + seed-alert config (Ben/Deliverability team)

Maya Rivera: Can we QA tomorrow? If all green, target Wed 11:00 PST for micro1 and Wed 12:00 PST for micro2, seeds on Tue 11:00 PST. Keep jitter +/- 20m to avoid spikes.

Ben Ortiz: Confirmed. I'll post the cohort exports and seed lists here when ready.

Lina Duarte: I'll prepare the measurement plan and null hypothesis: "A (semantic subject) will produce higher RSVP rate than B (technical subject) by at least 1.5 ppt." Will share spreadsheet.

Noah Patel: Great. Thanks team — aim to keep this tight and measurable. If we see RSVP lift, we can scale to the wider newsletter next month. :rocket:
